label: The arrival-time recurrence
subgoals: Assign fixed delays to cells and arrival times to inputs
Add a match's delay to the latest arrival among its inputs
Take the minimum over all matches at the node

label: Late inputs change the answer
subgoals: Read the arrival time of each primary input
Compare matches that place a late input near or far from the output
Pick the match that minimizes the latest input plus its delay

label: Area among delay-optimal covers
subgoals: Break arrival ties by the smaller subtree area
Compare the delay-optimal cover's area with the area optimum
Note that non-critical nodes need required times to trade delay for area
